cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.description: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.description: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.description: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed make this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.description: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it's a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.description: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Trumbeak
cards.description: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of call and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

cards.name: Toucannon
cards.description: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.description: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.description: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.description: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.description: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.description: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.description: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Fomantis
cards.description: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.description: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.description: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.description: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.description: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.description: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

cards.name: Litten
cards.description: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.description: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.description: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.description: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.description: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.description: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.description: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.description: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.description: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.description: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.description: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

cards.name: Brionne
cards.description: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.

cards.name: Primarina
cards.description: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learning from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.description: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.description: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.description: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.description: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.description: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.description: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.description: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.description: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.description: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can't move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.description: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

cards.name: Alolan Muk
cards.description: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it's ever eaten.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams. Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.description: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.description: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.description: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.description: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.description: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.description: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.description: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.description: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.description: It explores caves in search of underground water. It's not comfortable around water, so this Pokémon takes great care in lapping it up.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.description: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.description: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.description: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.description: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.description: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.description: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

cards.name: Alolan Raticate
cards.description: This gourmet Pokémon is particular about the taste and freshness of its food. Restaurants where Raticate live have a good reputation.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.description: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Alolan Persian
cards.description: Its round face and smooth coat—softer than the most high-class velvet—have made this a very popular Pokémon in Alola.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.description: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they rush to attack en masse. When alone, they're rather cowardly.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.description: It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.description: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.description: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.description: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.description: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.description: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.description: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it's satisfied.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous appetite and look after it.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: Drawings of a Pokémon resembling Fearow can be seen in murals from deep in ancient history.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: Kangaskhan's maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.
